description: This file declares the CdmState class which manages the state for ion sensing in the hardware layer, including current revolution, accumulator, and event count, as well as function declarations for initialization and post-processing.

classes.name: CdmState
classes.description: Class representing the state for ion sensing, including current revolution, accumulator, and event count, with methods to handle new signals and retrieve current value.

methods.name: onNewSignal
methods.description: Handles a new signal event, updating the current revolution and possibly other internal state.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the current value of the accumulated data.

methods.name: c`,dmIonInit
methods.description: Initializes the ion sense hardware layer.
